comparison_scope: Incumbent 4caa92df versus combined diagnostics/proof candidate 6a96c953; no pure-proof live TPS attribution.

measurement_window.selection: Non-null block_stats; basechain workchain/workchain_id=0; start <= collated_at < end. Pipeline prefers rounded generator *_unix_ms / 1000.
measurement_window.scope: Full accumulated cost of candidate records finishing inside the phase; not cost clipped at boundaries, unique canonical transfers, or the offered cohort.

stage_semantics: Checkpoint timing includes base/trial ProofStorageStat copying and add_proof traversal. CPU uses the executing thread clock; checkpoint scope is synchronous. Native commit encloses component stages: do not add parent/child timings. Values are printed to microsecond precision per candidate.

packing.semantics: Histogram populations include attempts/rollback; bins are not per-checkpoint timing strata. Missing fine telemetry in the incumbent is unavailable, never zero.

admission_full_run.semantics: Admission causes and timing means cover before/after full-run pool captures; retry counts cover generator attempts including retries/repairs. They cannot be divided by measured candidate accepted transfers.

pacing_measured.semantics: Measured clipped credits, exact boundary balances, worker-second issue holds and phase-intersected maxima. Worker seconds are not wall-time union; no values are synthesized for old images.

external_wait_measured.semantics: wall-clock-only external queue waits; the ten categories are mutually exclusive and each record should reconcile to wait_externals_time within max(100us, 0.1%); aggregate signed errors cannot hide a failing record

acceptance.semantics: proof correctness, run completion, signed-run physical quantum, requested/effective generator batching, ingress capacity, chain capacity, validator canonical cleanup, and reproducibility are independent acceptance dimensions

load_level_acceptance.semantics: load_validation proves the offered level only; it does not establish chain capacity

strict_image_reuse.semantics: prebuilt images; stable validator container/image and daemon PID/kernel start ticks across setup and load

dip_diagnostics.scope: Diagnostic report-aligned approximately ten-second windows within the measured phase; generator counters use asynchronous worker snapshots. Saved resource samples and whole candidate records use the same report endpoints. These are not canonical TPS or proof-stage causality estimates; no samples are removed from the full-arm metrics.
dip_diagnostics.window_selection_rule: Report at/after each elapsed 90+10*k boundary through last report before390; measured phase begins at90. Highlight offered delta below45000 (75% of fixed60000 target).
limitations: Incumbent lacks additive clipping/hold-duration/admission-cause telemetry. Cumulative RTT maxima are not interval RTT measurements.
Different candidate completion windows can consume already-admitted backlog during a generator offer dip; no causal link to proof traversal is established.

full_run_pressure_summary.scope: Full generator run, including ramp/warmup/drain. Counts are parent task outcomes, not RPC events; a query-level failure can fan out. Hold observations are neither durations nor mutually independent causes.
